title: Doubling Growth Policy
prompt:
Implement a growable vector with an explicit growth contract:
 
```c
int vec_push(int **buf, size_t *len, size_t *cap, int v);
```
 
Starts at capacity 1; when full, the capacity *doubles*; returns 0 on success, -1 if allocation fails (leave everything unchanged then).

tests.name: five pushes, cap 8
tests.hint: 1 doubles to 2, 4, 8; the fifth push triggers the 4-to-8 growth; values survive every move.

tests.name: first push allocates
tests.hint: The NULL/zero start must allocate capacity 1, not 0.
